query: SELECT tg.id as gene_id, tg.name as gene_name, m.id as molecule_id, m.name as molecule_name FROM tps_genes tg LEFT JOIN tps_gene_molecules tgm ON tg.id = tgm.tps_gene_id LEFT JOIN molecules m ON tgm.molecule_id = m.id LIMIT 5;
